connector.name: MCP Adyen
connector.registryDescription: MCP server for Adyen Checkout API v71 - enterprise payments (iFood, Uber, Spotify in LatAm)
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp-adyen. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the codespar account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: ADYEN_API_KEY
env.description: Adyen API key (generated in Customer Area → Developers → API credentials)

env.name: ADYEN_MERCHANT_ACCOUNT
env.description: Adyen merchant account code (appears in most request bodies)

env.name: ADYEN_LIVE_URL_PREFIX
env.description: Required when ADYEN_ENV=live. Your merchant-specific prefix, e.g. 1797a841fbb37ca7-AdyenDemo
